name: alva-skill-scenario-routing
description: Deterministic prompt-intent contracts for Alva skill routing. These scenarios do not call an LLM; they bind representative user prompts to the route, references, gates, and boundaries the skill docs must preserve.

scenarios.prompt: What is BTC doing right now?
scenarios.description: A simple latest-fact ask stays in Financial Analysis, uses fresh sourced evidence, and does not inherit playbook gates.

expect.top_level_route: Simple latest-fact asks stop there after one sourced hop
behaviors: Direct latest/realtime price for covered US equities and crypto: intraday klines, not daily-level bars or closes
Do not answer until you can name the decomposition
Do not let playbook creation become the default

scenarios.prompt: Is NVDA cheap versus peers after the latest earnings revision?
scenarios.description: A complex valuation ask uses the ask evidence gate plus Complex Ask Router without becoming a playbook by default.

scenarios.prompt: Does Alva have darkpool L2 realtime data?
scenarios.description: A capability-gap question verifies live coverage before saying no or moving to BYOD.

behaviors: custom data source URL / BYOD source

sections.heading: Capability Verification
sections.label: before refusal
includes: Before saying Alva lacks a capability
Never reject the whole as one unit from memory

scenarios.prompt: Build and publish a live dashboard for BTC dominance breakouts.
scenarios.description: A hosted dashboard enters the Playbook Creation route and preserves feed-first, live-read, README, lint, release, and screenshot gates.

behaviors: HTML fetches quantitative data from feeds, not inline literals

sections.heading: Freshness and version updates
sections.label: readme freshness
includes: Every `alva release playbook` call needs a freshly reviewed README

gates.label: playbook release
includes: README exists, is current, and is passed via absolute `--readme-url`

scenarios.prompt: Track BTC dominance and notify me when it breaks out.
scenarios.description: A monitoring request routes to Automation / Push, compares bounded history, suppresses repeated content, and validates delivery.

behaviors: Build or modify a feed that declares actionable outputs with `alertOutput(typeDoc)`
bounded history source and lookback window
A push is set up only after all of these succeed
A quiet V2 run does not append an alert record
`alva deploy trigger` is not a dry run
do not claim push is set up

sections.heading: Push Monitor
includes: quiet branch that does not append
`signal/targets` or `notify/message` only when maintaining an existing

sections.heading: Action Layer: Alerts
includes: New feeds declare push-worthy outputs with `alertOutput(typeDoc)`

gates.label: automation knowledge
includes: longitudinal or decision automations compare bounded history

scenarios.prompt: <session-prefill-channel-memory channel-id="44" root="/alva/home/ymchcom/channels/research/memory"> Notify this channel every minute with hello111.
scenarios.description: A request made in an Alva web topic channel binds the feed to that exact channel id and never invents Telegram delivery.

behaviors: a non-`alva` slug denotes a topic channel
do not silently fall back to the default destination
Do not infer Telegram, Discord, Slack, or another transport
Do not trigger the cronjob or wait for its next scheduled run solely to verify setup
A successful enable proves that alert delivery is configured
it does not prove that a message has already been delivered
An ALFS record alone is also not delivery proof
report it as an Alva web topic channel with its id
forbidden_behaviors: never as Telegram or another external DM

scenarios.prompt: Backtest a weekly NVDA momentum strategy and show drawdowns.
scenarios.description: A backtest routes through Strategy / Trading Analysis and requires Altra instead of hand-rolled loops.

behaviors: package results as a concise answer, feed, signal, or visual playbook depending on the request

scenarios.description: A Skillhub directive fetches the blueprint fresh, avoids bulk download, and only becomes a playbook if the user or blueprint asks.

behaviors: If the user's message contains `/use-skill:<username>/<name>`, the Skillhub path is mandatory
Do not turn every Skillhub task into a playbook

scenarios.prompt: Use the thesis skill for NVDA AI capex read-through.
scenarios.description: A user skill reference searches Skillhub for relevant catalog matches, resolves one obvious id, and then fetches the blueprint fresh.

behaviors: references a skill without an exact id
Proceed only when exactly one match is obvious
Do not turn every Skillhub task into a playbook

scenarios.prompt: 分析一下 MU 最近的公司表现，重点说清楚市场现在在看什么、最近异动和催化剂。
scenarios.description: A broad single-ticker read checks the official direct-read sources before generic search, selects rather than blindly running them all, and still uses Data Skills for live financial facts.

behaviors: Treat these as first-tier ticker-read sources
For every broad ticker read, check the Direct-read lane before generic search
Data Skills remain the source for live price, fundamentals, valuation
Do not execute every source by default
Continue with the remaining available Platform Data sources
Use `alva/company-anomaly-read` as the first direct-read check for intraday and hourly-scale market tracking

scenarios.prompt: 帮我看看 NVDA 过去一小时有没有异常，为什么？
scenarios.description: An hour-scale ticker check prioritizes the published anomaly timeline and current episode attribution before slower investor-focus or generic discovery sources.

behaviors: Use `alva/company-anomaly-read` as the first direct-read check for intraday and hourly-scale market tracking
roughly every 15 minutes during US market hours
A quiet state does not prove that price was flat
Data Skills for the live price

scenarios.prompt: 三星电子 005930.KS 昨天为什么大涨？
scenarios.description: An uncovered or non-US move falls back from the published anomaly feed to custom aggregation and attribution without pretending that aggregation itself detected an anomaly.

behaviors: off-list, non-US, user-defined, or otherwise uncovered move
Attribution assumes an already-identified anomalous move
does not silently become an Automation or Playbook
If either method is unavailable in the active profile

scenarios.prompt: TSLA 现在投资者最关注什么？今天有没有可能影响它的突发事件？
scenarios.description: Investor-focus and breaking-event questions combine WILF with the macro breaking-news feed while preserving each source's freshness, coverage, and evidence limits.

behaviors: did not surface a matching event

scenarios.description: A remix reads source artifacts and preserves lineage instead of regenerating from memory.

behaviors: Extract source owner/name from the tag URL
read the source feed scripts, HTML, README, and playbook metadata
preserve them unless the user explicitly asks otherwise

scenarios.description: An annotation edit changes the generator behind the element and re-enters HTML gates.

behaviors: change the generator behind the selected element
Never freeze rendered feed values into static text

gates.label: html gate
includes: The HTML follows the Browser request rule
Do not rely on memory of prior sessions

scenarios.prompt: Add a button so viewers can run my custom analysis function.
scenarios.description: A UDF request is explicit opt-in and routes to the PBSV/browser runtime and functions CLI checks.
